name: Taming fawn into giant stag mount
summary:
**Conversation Overview**

The person is a new player in the MMO game Albion Online who found an Adept's Fawn and wanted to turn it into a tamed Giant Stag mount. Claude walked through the full process: building a Pasture on a Player Island (requiring island level 2+, built with 30 Rough Logs, 30 Rough Stone, 30 Chestnut Planks, and 30 Sandstone Blocks), placing the fawn, feeding it crops, waiting 92 hours (46 with Premium), and then crafting the final mount at a Saddler using the Tame Giant Stag plus 20 Worked Leather.

The person was in Martlock and asked for directions from the marketplace to the Island Merchant. Claude directed them west toward the NPC cluster, looking for the island icon on the minimap. The person then discovered they needed Premium to purchase an island, and Claude initially provided outdated information suggesting 7 days of Premium was available — the person corrected this. Claude acknowledged the error and clarified that Premium is purchased through the shop with real money (minimum 30 days) or with in-game silver, which costs approximately 29 million silver per month — an amount the person noted is not realistically achievable as a new player. The conversation ended with Claude acknowledging the new-player catch-22 and noting the shop route as the practical near-term option, with the person's decision left open.

Here's the full breakdown:

---

**Step 1 — Build a Pasture**

You need a **Player Island at level 2 or higher** to get a farming plot. A level 1 island doesn't have a farming plot — you need at least level 2. Once you have the dirt/dark soil plot, stand on it, press **H** to open the build menu, go to the **Farming tab**, and select Pasture.

Building a Pasture costs: 30 Rough Logs, 30 Rough Stone, 30 Chestnut Planks, and 30 Sandstone Blocks.

If you don't want to build your own, you can use a guildie's pasture or look for a public one — but your own island is the most reliable path.

---

**Step 2 — Place the Fawn**

Open your inventory, click the Adept's Fawn, and select "Place." Up to 9 fawns can be placed on a single pasture, and you need a farming level of T4 Animal Breeder to place it.

---

**Step 3 — Feed It**

Stags are herbivores — feed them crops. Carrots work fine and are the cheapest option. The animal won't grow without food in the pasture.

---

**Step 4 — Wait for Growth**

Grow time is 92 hours, halved to 46 hours with Premium.

---

**Step 5 — Craft the Mount**

Once the fawn matures into an **Adept's Tame Giant Stag**, take it to a **Saddler**. Craft the Adept's Giant Stag at the Saddler using the Tame Giant Stag and 20 Worked Leather.

---

**TL;DR path:** Island level 2+ → build Pasture (30 Rough Logs/Stone/Chestnut Planks/Sandstone Blocks) → place fawn → feed crops → 92hr wait (46 with Premium) → Saddler + 20 Worked Leather = mount.

content.title: Island Farms - Albion Online Wiki
content.text:
Albion Online features a system that allows players to grow crops, herbs, and animals. Farming requires you to own a Farm, Herb Garden, Pasture or Kennel. These can be built on any plot of an appropriate size on your Island, up to a maximum of 16 plots per island.

Albion Online features a system that allows players to grow crops, herbs, and animals. Farming requires you to own a Farm, Herb Garden, Pasture or Kennel. These can be built on any plot of an appropriate size on your Island, up to a maximum of 16 plots per island. The crops, herbs, and animals can be used, sold, or crafted into food, potions, or mounts. Introduced in Wild Blood Update, each Royal City provides a Local Production Bonus of +10% for 1 Crop, 1 Herb, 1 Livestock Animal and an additional bonus, with Caerleon having a bonus for 3 Herbs and Brecilien for all crops. Crop Farming and Herbalism allows for growing crops used for feeding animals, cooking food, and creating food and potions. Each plot can plant 9 seeds; they can be distinct or the same. All seeds need 22 hours to fully grow. Each harvested seed yields 3-6 of its crop (6-12 with premium) and gives 100 fame (+50 for premium).

They provide the player with the capability to farm, raise animals, refine resources, and craft armor without having to do it someplace else (Farming can only be done on Player Islands or Farm Territories). Players may provide access to their island to any player, guild, or alliance they wish.

The Player Island is one of two types of player-made islands, the other being a Guild Island. Islands are used to create unique buildings otherwise not available in cities. This opens new skills and item crafting, as well as a new skill unique to islands and farm territories: Farming. PvP is not enabled on a Player Island. A player may have one Island in each Royal City and one Island in Brecilien. Travel to the Player Island is free as long as the player is in the same city the Island is located. Player islands may be purchased from the Island Merchant in any of the main cities. To purchase an Island, a player must have purchased at least 7 days' Premium time. The player must then provide resources and refined materials to the building in order to complete it. To manage a building, click on the building and select the character portrait at the top of the left panel. This will open a menu with various building management options which are explained below. This section allows a player to see who owns the building and who built it. Players may set the building's permissions here. Building Attackable: Allows players to attack the building, causing Durability loss. Give Up: This gives up ownership rights to the building. It changes the owner to "System" and may be claimed by any player. To undo this option, select "Claim".

Demolish: Demolishes the building, providing 90% of the materials spent to construct it. Demolition takes one minute and may be canceled during that time. Demolition time is the same as downgrade: 24 hours if started by a co-owner or 60 seconds if started by the owner. This section allows a player to feed the building's worker, increasing its Nutrition. Many buildings have a Favorite Dish. While any food may be used, the Favorite Dish provides double the Nutrition. Here's the full breakdown:

---

**Step 1 — Build a Pasture**

You need a **Player Island at level 2 or higher** to get a farming plot. A level 1 island doesn't have a farming plot — you need at least level 2. Once you have the dirt/dark soil plot, stand on it, press **H** to open the build menu, go to the **Farming tab**, and select Pasture.

Building a Pasture costs: 30 Rough Logs, 30 Rough Stone, 30 Chestnut Planks, and 30 Sandstone Blocks.

If you don't want to build your own, you can use a guildie's pasture or look for a public one — but your own island is the most reliable path.

---

**Step 2 — Place the Fawn**

Open your inventory, click the Adept's Fawn, and select "Place." Up to 9 fawns can be placed on a single pasture, and you need a farming level of T4 Animal Breeder to place it.

---

**Step 3 — Feed It**

Stags are herbivores — feed them crops. Carrots work fine and are the cheapest option. The animal won't grow without food in the pasture.

---

**Step 4 — Wait for Growth**

Grow time is 92 hours, halved to 46 hours with Premium.

---

**Step 5 — Craft the Mount**

Once the fawn matures into an **Adept's Tame Giant Stag**, take it to a **Saddler**. Craft the Adept's Giant Stag at the Saddler using the Tame Giant Stag and 20 Worked Leather.

---

**TL;DR path:** Island level 2+ → build Pasture (30 Rough Logs/Stone/Chestnut Planks/Sandstone Blocks) → place fawn → feed crops → 92hr wait (46 with Premium) → Saddler + 20 Worked Leather = mount.

Everything on your Island, including loot in your chests, will transfer to the new Island location. Player Islands are helpful in a variety of ways. They provide the player with the capability to farm, raise animals, refine resources, and craft armor without having to do it someplace else (Farming can only be done on Player Islands or Farm Territories). Farming allows the player to plant seeds to grow crops and herbs in a Farm and Herb Garden. You can raise animals in a Kennel, or a Pasture. Good news — you don't have to go far. There is an Island Merchant in every major city, so Martlock has one.

In the major cities, the Island Merchant is to the left of the portal for expeditions, in the NPC area of the city. In Martlock specifically, the Island Merchant is on the west side of the NPC area.

From the marketplace:

1. Exit the marketplace building
2. Head **west** toward the NPC cluster
3. Look for the NPC with a **palm beach/island sign** icon on your minimap
4. That's your Island Merchant

You'll need at least 7 days of Premium time purchased before you can buy an island. The island itself costs **12,500 silver** and will be tied to Martlock — travel to it from Martlock will always be free.
